# Dry run: repeated-premise circuit breaker

This is an executable-policy transcript fixture, not evidence that a language
model will comply mechanically.

1. Round 1 full review blocks with R-007, claiming the authoritative source
   requires a fresh full review after every narrow correction.
2. The top-level session corrects the cited wording without expanding the risk
   surface. Round 2 correction review blocks on the same finding family R-007
   and the same requirement premise.
3. Two consecutive blocks now trigger requirement adjudication. Correction work
   stops; the third code-review invocation is not launched. The adjudicator
   reconstructs the disputed rule from ADR 0024 and either resolves it or returns
   one precise owner decision. No blocker is auto-approved.
